title: Bailey bridge built after Calungbuyan Bridge closure in Ilocos Sur

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) has begun constructing a Bailey bridge in Santa, Ilocos Sur, to provide temporary access to residents and motorists after the Calungbuyan Bridge was closed due to damage caused by continuous rains. Invented by British engineer Sir Donald Coleman Bailey in 1940, a Bailey bridge is a prefabricated single-lane bridge that can be installed relatively quickly using interchangeable, high-tensile steel panels. In an advisory on Tuesday (Sept. 15), the DPWH Ilocos Sur 2nd District Engineering Office started the construction of the temporary bridge after damage was observed on the approach […]...
